name: skafld-vc-files
description: Optional add-on for SkaFld VC on a computer with Node.js 18 or later: SkaFld VC's own branded HTML, Word, PDF, PowerPoint and Excel files, brand setup from your website, a firm profile saved across projects, and the rubric scorer as a tool. Without it SkaFld VC makes files with Claude's own document tools and scores with its Python scorer.

interface.shortDescription: Branded files and exact scoring for SkaFld VC (needs Node.js)
